clients.name: EmbeddingProvider
clients.description:
EmbeddingProvider is a client class that provides an interface for generating
vector embeddings via the OpenRouter unified API, which supports embedding models
from OpenAI, Google, Mistral, and other providers.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the OpenRouter embedding provider with the given configuration.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: The OpenRouter API key (obtain from https://openrouter.ai/keys)

parameters.name: modelType
parameters.description: The embedding model to use (e.g., `openai/text-embedding-3-small`)

parameters.name: serviceUrl
parameters.description: The base URL of the OpenRouter API endpoint

parameters.name: siteUrl
parameters.description: Optional site URL sent as `HTTP-Referer` header for OpenRouter attribution

parameters.name: siteName
parameters.description: Optional site name sent as `X-OpenRouter-Title` header for OpenRouter attribution

parameters.name: httpVersion
parameters.description: The HTTP version understood by the client

parameters.name: http1Settings
parameters.description: Configurations related to HTTP/1.x protocol

parameters.name: http2Settings
parameters.description: Configurations related to HTTP/2 protocol

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The maximum time to wait (in seconds) for a response before closing the connection

parameters.name: forwarded
parameters.description: The choice of setting `forwarded`/`x-forwarded` header

parameters.name: poolConfig
parameters.description: Configurations associated with request pooling

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: HTTP caching related configurations

parameters.name: compression
parameters.description: Specifies the way of handling compression (`accept-encoding`) header

parameters.name: circuitBreaker
parameters.description: Configurations associated with the behaviour of the Circuit Breaker

parameters.name: retryConfig
parameters.description: Configurations associated with retrying

parameters.name: responseLimits
parameters.description: Configurations associated with inbound response size limits

parameters.name: secureSocket
parameters.description: SSL/TLS-related options

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Proxy server related options

parameters.name: validation
parameters.description: Enables the inbound payload validation functionality which provided by the constraint package. Enabled by default

parameters.name: connectionConfig
parameters.description: Additional HTTP connection configuration

return.description: `()` on successful initialization; otherwise, returns an `ai:Error`

functions.name: embed
functions.description: Converts the given chunk into a vector embedding.

parameters.name: chunk
parameters.description: The chunk to convert into an embedding (only `ai:TextChunk` and `ai:TextDocument` are supported)

functions.name: batchEmbed
functions.description: Converts a batch of chunks into vector embeddings.

parameters.name: chunks
parameters.description: The chunks to convert into embeddings (only `ai:TextChunk` and `ai:TextDocument` are supported)

clients.name: ModelProvider
clients.description:
ModelProvider is a client class that provides an interface for interacting with
LLMs via the OpenRouter unified API, which supports models from OpenAI, Anthropic,
Google, Meta, Mistral, and many other providers.

functions.name: chat
functions.description: Sends a chat request to the OpenRouter model with the given messages and tools.

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: List of chat messages or a single user message

parameters.name: tools
parameters.description: Tool definitions to be used for the tool call

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: Stop sequence to stop the completion

return.description: Function to be called, chat response or an error in-case of failures

functions.name: generate
functions.description:
Sends a chat request to the model and generates a value of the type specified by
the `td` type descriptor. For complex record types, annotate the type with
`@ai:JsonSchema` to enable compile-time schema generation.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The prompt to use in the chat messages

parameters.name: td
parameters.description: Type descriptor specifying the expected return type format

return.description: Generates a value that belongs to the type, or an error if generation fails
